pages.text: The plain Logistics Card whitelists $(bold)one$() item. The Gilded, Crystal and Netherforged cards are the same card with $(bold)4, 16 and 64$() reference slots: a stack passes if it matches $(bold)any$() of them, and the flags (Match Comps, Has Enchants, Blacklist...) still apply on top.

Upgrade in the crafting grid: card + $(bold)gold ingot$() -> Gilded, + $(bold)diamond$() -> Crystal, + $(bold)netherite ingot$() -> Netherforged. The card keeps its filter, its binding, its mode and its speed, so you can grow a card you already set up. They work everywhere a Logistics Card works: pipes, the router, the Batch Distributor.
